data: Which of the lines in the graph are below 10 at the point marked 25 on the x-axis?

The question asks which lines in the graph are below 10 at the point marked 25 on the x-axis. From the analysis of the graph:

1. The x-axis represents the amount of training data in shards, with each shard being about 24 minutes.
2. The y-axis represents MCD on the evaluation set, ranging from 0 to 30.
3. At the point marked 25 on the x-axis, the T-Dec line is below 10, while the other lines (T-Base, T-Enc, and T-Enc-Dec) are above 10.

Therefore, the line below 10 at the point marked 25 on the x-axis is the T-Dec line.
